Frozen OpenSSF MAL-2025-6020 records is@3.3.1 and 5.0.0 as unauthorized versions with malicious obfuscated code via account compromise. A dated StepSecurity report independently names the exact pair and 19 July 2025 timeline; the project maintainer's v3.3.2 changelog independently states that the pair contained malware from a hijacked account. The official registry time of is@3.3.1 is the earliest selected malicious publication and defines the strict cutoff. This is one bounded family record and does not assert completeness for any broader phishing activity.
